question: A consultant on a paid plan is checking how much material she can work with inside one chat. Which two statements are correct? Select two.
options: A) The context window grows automatically as soon as she upgrades to a higher paid plan.
B) The largest chat context window is offered on Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 only.
C) Every model on a paid plan offers exactly the same context window inside a single chat.
D) A usage limit covers how much she interacts over a period, not what fits in one chat.
E) Her remaining usage allowance is what decides how much one chat can hold at any time.
correct_answers: B) The largest chat context window is offered on Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5 only.
D) A usage limit covers how much she interacts over a period, not what fits in one chat.
explanations: Incorrect. The window is tied to the model in use, not to how high the plan tier is.
Correct. In chat, the largest context window is limited to Claude Opus 5 and Claude Sonnet 5; other models sit at smaller sizes.
Incorrect. Context window size varies by model, so a paid plan on its own does not give every model the same window.
Correct. A usage limit is a budget for interaction over a time period, while the context window is the working memory of one conversation.
Incorrect. This is the classic confusion between usage limits and length limits; the allowance does not set a chat's capacity.
